description: Generate an AI-optimized resume tailored for a specific job application. This creates a customized version of your resume highlighting relevant skills and experience for the job. Returns JSON resume data.

applicationId.description: The job application ID to generate a resume for

generatePdf.description: Generate a downloadable PDF from the resume (default: false). When true, returns a PDF download URL.

keywords.description: Specific keywords to emphasize in the resume

modifications.description: Custom modifications or instructions for resume customization

sections.description: Which resume sections to AI-enhance. Defaults to ["summary", "work", "skills"] if not specified.

name: generate_resume_for_job
